features.title: Source text and lexical forms
pending: Invalid UTF-8 source and diagnostic positions; CRLF and source normalization
Unicode identifier categories, remaining reserved contexts and malformed literal contracts
features.note: ASCII callable suffixes, reserved declarations/parameters/members/argument labels and maximal operator tokens are covered across ordinary execution and retained REPL state. Type parsing preserves nested generic angles and later origins. Symbols and Hash labels retain literal names; reserved value names cannot resolve. The pinned reference also rejects an adjacent bang/equality spelling. Unicode identifiers and remaining lexical boundaries stay open.

features.title: Strings and UTF-8
pending: Remaining String receiver APIs
Embedded-expression boundaries beyond the reviewed interpolation probes
features.note: Ordinary UTF-8 literals, code-point size/index, collections and NUL/long data are covered. Additional CLI tests cover argv, invalid source, forced GC and terminal editing. String empty/include/start/end queries and nullable first/last search now share code-point offsets, argument ordering, optional receivers and managed lifetime checks. The remaining String APIs stay open. Chars, codepoints and reverse preserve code-point units, independent result storage, NUL, optional receivers and managed lifetimes. String slice now accepts checked code-point ranges, retaining receiver identity and optional short circuit; negative, reversed and out-of-bounds ranges fail explicitly. Control, octal, hex and scalar Unicode escapes preserve exact bytes, reject invalid scalar/digit forms and do not recursively start interpolation. Strip, lstrip and rstrip use the reference Unicode White_Space set, preserve retained bytes and manage optional, generic, captured and stored values.

features.title: Numeric and Boolean operations
pending: All operators and assignment forms; mixed widening and every portable failure boundary
Short-circuit side effects and invalid RHS diagnostics across nested control
features.note: Integer and Float receiver operations, scalar String conversion and Float output use typed MIR and checked portable conversions. Shared probes cover ties, asymmetric rounding intervals, limits, subnormals, signed zero, NaN, infinities, optional calls, constants and managed captures; broader numeric APIs and general REPL Float display remain open.

features.title: Bindings, constants and mutation
pending: Shadowing, duplicate declarations, unused/discard bindings and mutation through projections
lowercase namespace-body variables; untyped empty collection inference
features.note: File/project and interactive lowercase variables preserve source identity, shared mutable storage, lexical shadowing, nullable proof invalidation and managed roots. Retained named functions and anonymous captures share cells; typed witnesses never rerun initializers. Authored order survives load/replay. Lowercase namespace-body declarations, forward initialization and untyped collection inference remain explicit pending contracts.

features.title: Function declarations and calls
pending: Every all-path return, evaluation-order and mutable-argument boundary

features.title: Defaults and named arguments
pending: Method, function-value and payload-enum argument parity
features.note: Positional and named-only defaults have declaration-scoped, typed MIR initializer bodies. Explicit expressions precede omitted defaults; checking and the REPL share binding identities.

features.title: Conditions and value-producing branches
pending: Nullable/union common result types and broader expression nesting boundaries
features.note: Value branches have typed MIR joins, numeric widening and lexical transfer propagation; shared probes cover effects, scope and managed aliases.

features.title: Loop control and transfers
pending: Additional nested transfer and diagnostic-origin differential probes
features.note: Conditional return, break and next evaluate the guard first and share lexical targets with MIR and the REPL.

features.title: Case statements and expressions
pending: Exhaustiveness, repeated/unreachable branches and pattern-binding diagnostics
features.note: Integer and String selectors with literal alternatives are supported; value-producing cases currently require else.

features.title: Records and field bindings
pending: Nominal cycles and defaults involving remaining unsupported value types
features.note: Generic and ordinary defaults share declaration-scoped initializers; explicit fields run before omitted defaults, with fresh managed values and independent concrete type instances.

features.title: Member access and projections
pending: Safe member access, chained field narrowing and receiver replacement

features.title: Nullable values and narrowing
pending: Class/callback and general pattern narrowing; collection/union optional conversions
Nullable standard-library methods beyond the currently implemented Native APIs
features.note: Native uses explicit typed none/present/test/extraction MIR with traced payload storage and checked extraction. Direct lexical/stable record-field guards, returning guards, short-circuit RHS and safe navigation are covered; chained predicates do not export extra narrowing facts. Retained REPL assignments use checked exit facts; partial failure and interruption clear earlier narrowing. Conditional/failure probes expose known bugs in the fixed reference revision, and statement-control result display remains different. Optional scalar output uses verified branches and payload extraction and matches current reference output separately for ordinary execution and the REPL.

features.title: Enums and tagged values
pending: Method-specific type parameters, enum attributes and wider pattern forms
Reference REPL initializer replay (TypeRB #768) and shadowed standard error identity (#769); imported/nested REPL presentation parity
features.note: Ordinary/raw/payload enums, explicit String/Integer representations, checked Result conversions and instance methods use verified MIR. Generic enum receiver arguments specialize defaults, recursive/private calls and closures before MIR catalogs freeze. Shared and retained-session cases cover aliases, imports, nullable calls and rejected templates. Method-specific parameters, attributes, reference defects and display gaps remain explicit.

features.title: Transparent aliases
pending: Literal/discriminated union and class/interface alias targets
Authored alias spelling in REPL display and diagnostics
features.note: Transparent and generic aliases resolve to canonical checked types before MIR. Probes cover declaration scope, recursive nominal targets, defaults, Result, enum patterns and invalid unused aliases. Pinned reference defects remain explicit.

features.title: Nominal newtypes
pending: Class/interface representation dependencies
Method-specific generic parameters with the remaining callable/generic family
features.note: Explicit nominal construction/projection and open or closed methods preserve identity through aliases, imports, managed values, nullable calls, captures and MIR storage erasure. Independent verification and ordinary/retained-session cases cover representation, lifetime and rejection boundaries. General union output and Hash presentation differences remain explicit.

features.title: Generic declarations and applications
pending: Method-specific type parameters, generic classes and interfaces
Wider constraints and type applications
features.note: Explicit record/enum and top-level function applications use concrete checked MIR. Function templates and record/parameter defaults are checked even when unused. Imported generic enum identity, local shadowing and full control defaults agree with the updated reference; remaining Hash REPL display differences stay explicit.

features.title: Union values, literal types and discriminated unions
pending: Class discriminants and their readonly-field rules with the object family
Reference grouped annotation and nullable-alternative boundaries (TypeRB #764 and #765); composite type patterns remain staged in the reference
features.note: General and literal unions compose with collections, optional values, generics, aliases, nominal payloads, Results and closures through verified MIR. Singleton constraints widen explicitly; literal cases, common record members and overlapping discriminants preserve exhaustive checking and mutation invalidation. Homogeneous literal-union Hash keys retain typed identity through value-based lookup, copies and snapshots. Shared cases retain reference defects and REPL presentation differences.

features.title: Function values and lexical capture
pending: Callable equality, method references and remaining parameter-capability/narrowing combinations
features.note: Ordinary files and retained REPL submissions construct anonymous and named function values using concrete checked bodies and their originating code/type catalogs. Required positional named declarations preserve import identity, lexical shadowing, managed storage, nullable narrowing, Result obligations and generic type applications. Defaults, named-only and generic declarations require explicit fn adapters. CLI controls additionally cover cross-submission calls, failures, collection and replay. Other boundaries and diagnostic differences remain explicit.

features.title: Arrays and checked indexes
pending: Safe collection lookup and conversion APIs
Wider invalid element/mutation combinations
features.note: Array edges/copies/slicing, mutable insertion/removal, scalar/payloadless equality queries, uniqueness, shallow concatenation and String joining share typed MIR and REPL behavior. Cases cover retained receivers, argument effects, nullable calls, managed aliases, Unicode/NUL, NaN and signed zero. Remaining methods and diagnostic differences stay explicit. Stable non-destructive sort/sort_descending support non-nullable Integer/Float/String elements, with NaNs last in both directions, signed-zero stability and byte-preserving Unicode order. Float/NUL presentation and inline callable-array reading remain explicit REPL differences. sort_by/sort_by_descending retain visited values and evaluate one portable Integer/Float/String key per element. Safe block navigation remains an explicit reference defect (type-rb/type-rb#774).

features.title: Hash values and operations
pending: All key/value representations, empty inference, managed lifetimes and missing-key failures
features.note: Colon keys support quoted and computed String keys, Integer keys and parenthesized identifier labels, retaining authored key/value evaluation order. Boolean and nil keys remain rejected. Homogeneous Integer/String literal-union keys use payload equality while snapshots preserve the exact key type. Growth, deletion, copies, nullable refinement and managed lifetimes are covered; mixed and nullable keys remain rejected.

features.title: Structured and value-producing iteration
pending: Remaining receiver APIs that shorten or reorder an Array during traversal
features.note: Array and Range each/map/select/reduce use shared checked statement bodies and ordinary MIR loops. Transforms retain one receiver, observe live Array growth/replacement, preserve visited selection values and evaluate reduce initializers before traversal. Indexed map/select and managed captures are covered. Short-circuit any?/all?/none? retain the same live source, require Boolean results and lower early exits to ordinary MIR edges. find/find_index retain visited values and produce checked nullable results with short-circuit exits. Hash each snapshots keys and values before its body; insertion, deletion, rebinding, managed aliases and loop transfers are covered without promising enumeration order. Array sort_by/sort_by_descending collect retained values and keys once through the same live iteration, then stably sort paired private buffers through ordinary MIR control flow.

features.title: Range values and boundaries
features.note: Materialization shares each endpoint rules, creates a fresh Array and exits before incrementing an inclusive portable maximum.

features.title: Result and typed propagation
pending: General union errors and compiler-declared structured package boundaries
features.note: Compiler-owned Result/Unit, ordinary case/try/catch, required-use and managed payloads use existing verified enum/control MIR. REPL controls cover automatic roots, aliases, retained values and reload. Optional error widening exposes a fixed-reference build/REPL defect; current reference main handles it correctly.

features.title: Classes, fields and methods
pending: Initialization, inheritance, dispatch, privacy and readonly fields

features.title: Explicit interface conformance
pending: Generic conformance, variance, inherited contracts and rejection controls

features.title: Modules and constant lookup
pending: Forward initialization dependencies and cycles; remaining module method boundaries
features.note: Nested/reopened namespaces, lexical privacy, ordered runtime constants, imported inferred types and qualified generic aliases are implemented. Reference issues #755 and #756 remain explicit boundaries; classes belong to the object-declaration family.

features.title: Symbol values
pending: Single-quoted Symbol spellings and Unicode identifier names
Remaining reference operator/control framing and multiline interpolation boundaries
features.note: Portable identifier and double-quoted Symbol spellings are String values. Shared cases cover equality, methods, defaults, generic/optional values, captures and storage. Quoted interpolation-looking contents stay literal; parser-selected normalization preserves Hash/named-argument context. Keyword Symbols also frame correctly in the REPL. Single-quote/operator spelling and multiline interpolation gaps remain explicit. Maximal operator spelling, callable-suffix names and reserved Hash/Symbol labels are now covered; Hash REPL ordering/format differences remain visible.

features.title: Project imports and declaration identity
pending: Bare/named aliases, graph conflicts, missing/unused imports and file/project/REPL identity
features.note: Named aliases, automatic project imports, record binding identity and standard-package aliases have ordinary probes; broader import and diagnostic contracts remain.

features.title: Target source interop
pending: Go/Ruby/TypeScript source emission and platform interop
features.note: A later toolchain contract is required; these remain project goals, not basic Native support claims.

features.title: JSX and web bindings
pending: Typed JSX and official web-package boundaries
features.note: Requires the source backend and web package contracts; remains in the complete toolchain goal.

features.title: Package capability activation
pending: Package-owned activation and resolution
features.note: Requires package resolution and its capability contract; remains in the complete toolchain goal.

features.title: Retired authored attempt syntax
features.note: The reference AST retains this node for pre-0.3 recovery; authored attempt syntax is rejected, not a language capability to implement.

def trace(label: String, value: String): String
	puts(label)
	return value + "!"
end

def collect(mut values: Array<String> = [], *, label: String = trace("default-label", "item")): String
	values.push(label)
	return values.size().to_s() + ":" + values[0]
end

def select(first: Integer, second: Integer = first + 1, *, third: Integer = second + 1): Integer
	return first * 100 + second * 10 + third
end

def fresh_hash(mut values: Hash<String, Array<String>> = { "key" =>["kept"] }): Integer
	mut items := values["key"]
	items.push("grown")
	return items.size()
end

record Entry
	first: String
	second: String = trace("default-second", first)
	items: Array<String> = [second]
	count: Float = items.size()
end

def identity(*, entry: Entry = Entry.new(first: trace("default-first", "record"))): Entry
	return entry
end

def lazy(value: Boolean = false && (1 / 0 == 0)): Boolean
	return value
end

def probe()
	puts(collect())
	puts(collect())
	mut values := ["explicit"]
	puts(collect(values, label: trace("explicit-label", "later")))
	puts(values.size())
	puts(select(1))
	puts(select(1, third: 8))
	puts(select(1, 4))
	puts(fresh_hash())
	puts(fresh_hash())
	first := Entry.new(second: trace("explicit-second", "second"), first: trace("explicit-first", "first"))
	puts(first.first)
	puts(first.second)
	puts(first.items[0])
	puts(first.count.to_i())
	second := identity()
	third := identity()
	mut items := second.items
	items.push("added")
	puts(items.size())
	puts(third.items.size())
	puts(third.items[0])
	puts(lazy())
	puts(lazy(true))
end

cases.title: Brace iteration with nested controls and lexical transfers
cases.declarations:
def probe(): Integer
	mut values := ["a", "b" + "b"]
	mut total := 0
	values.each.with_index { |value, index|
		if index == 0
			values.push("c" + "cc")
			next
		end
		(1..3).each { |step|
			if step == 2
				next
			end
			mut turn := 0
			while turn < 3
				turn += 1
				break if turn == 2
				total += value.size() + index + step
			end
			break if step == 3
		}
		if index == 2
			return total
		end
	}
	return - 1
end

def brace_controls()
	puts(probe())
	[1, 2].each { |value| if value == 1; puts("first"); else; puts("second"); end }
	(2...4).each() { |value|
		case value
		when 2
			puts("two")
		else
			puts("three")
		end
	}
end

cases.title: Short-circuit Array and Range predicates and boundary values
cases.declarations:
def probe()
	empty: Array<Integer> := []
	missing := empty.any? { |item| item > 0 }
	complete := empty.all? { |item| item > 0 }
	absent := empty.none? { |item| item > 0 }
	puts(missing)
	puts(complete)
	puts(absent)
	mut visits := 0
	found := [1, 2, 3].any? do |item|
		visits += 1
		item == 2
	end
	puts(found)
	puts(visits)
	visits = 0
	every := [1, 2, 3].all?() do |item|
		visits += 1
		item < 2
	end
	puts(every)
	puts(visits)
	visits = 0
	no_match := [1, 2, 3].none? do |item|
		visits += 1
		item == 2
	end
	puts(no_match)
	puts(visits)
	all_small := [1, 2].all? { |item| item < 3 }
	none_small := [1, 2].none? { |item| item > 3 }
	any_large := [1, 2].any? { |item| item > 3 }
	puts(all_small)
	puts(none_small)
	puts(any_large)
	maximum := (9007199254740991..9007199254740991).all? { |item| item > 0 }
	excluded := (9007199254740991...9007199254740991).any? { |item| item > 0 }
	reversed := (3..1).none? { |item| item > 0 }
	puts(maximum)
	puts(excluded)
	puts(reversed)
	# Stop after the second element.
	finite := (1..3).any? { |item| item == 2 }
	puts(finite)
	mut outer := 0
	nested := [1, 2].all? do |item|
		outer += 1
		answer := (1..3).any? { |other| item == other }
		answer
	end
	puts(nested)
	puts(outer)
	# Lazy evaluation must skip the zero divisor after the first match.
	lazy := [1, 0].any? { |item| 10 / item > 0 }
	puts(lazy)
end

def optional_absolute(value: Integer?): Integer?
	return value&.abs()
end

def record_value(mut events: Array<Integer>, tag: Integer, value: Integer): Integer
	events.push(tag)
	return value
end

def probe()
	mut events: Array<Integer> := []
	result := record_value(events, 1, - 5).clamp(record_value(events, 2, - 2), record_value(events, 3, 2))
	puts(result)
	events.each { |item| puts(item) }
	mut maybe: Integer? := nil
	absent := maybe&.clamp(record_value(events, 4, 0), record_value(events, 5, 1))
	puts(absent == nil)
	puts(events.size())
	maybe =- 7
	present := optional_absolute(maybe)
	if present != nil
		puts(present)
	end
	callback := fn(value: Integer): Integer
		return value.abs().clamp(2, 5)
	end
	mapped := [- 7, 1, 3].map { |value| callback(value) }
	mapped.each { |value| puts(value) }
	text := "held" + result.to_s()
	puts(text)
end

def add(value: Integer): Integer

end
def triple(value: Integer): Integer

record Holder
callback: Callback
end

def probe()
present: Holder? := Holder.new(callback: add)
absent: Holder? := nil
mut calls := 0
argument := fn(): Integer
calls += 1
return 3
end
value := present&.callback(argument())
if value != nil
puts(value)
end
puts(absent&.callback(argument()) == nil)
puts(calls)
end

cases.title: Float and Boolean conversion, special values and rounding boundaries
cases.declarations:
def power(exponent: Integer): Float
	mut value := 1.0
	mut index := 0
	while index > exponent
		value = value / 2.0
		index -= 1
	end
	while index < exponent
		value = value * 2.0
		index += 1
	end
	return value
end

def divide(value: Float): Float
	return 1.0 / value
end

cases.title: Array keyed ordering: managed narrowed
cases.declarations:
record Entry
	key: String
	value: String
end

def sorted(values: Array<Entry>): Array<Entry>
	return values.sort_by { |entry| entry.key + "!" }
end

def exercise()
	part := "ab"
	entries := [Entry.new(key: part + "c", value: "first"), Entry.new(key: "a", value: "second"), Entry.new(key: part + "c", value: "third")]
	mut result := sorted(entries)
	result.each { |entry| puts(entry.value) }
	result[0] = Entry.new(key: "z", value: "changed")
	puts(entries[1].value)
	read := fn(): String
		return entries.sort_by_descending { |entry| entry.key }[0].value
	end
	puts(read())
	optional: Array<Entry>? := entries
	if optional != nil
		ordered := optional.sort_by { |entry| entry.key }
		puts(ordered[0].value)
	end
	absent: Array<Entry>? := nil
	mut calls := 0
	if absent != nil
		missing := absent.sort_by do |entry|
			calls += 1
			entry.key
		end
		puts(missing.size())
	end
	puts(absent == nil)
	puts(calls)
end

def visit(values: Array<Integer>?): Integer
	mut total := 0
	values&.each.with_index do |value, index|
		if value == 2

			break
		end
		total += value * 10 + index
	end
	return total
end

def early(values: Range<Integer>?): Integer
	values&.each do |value|
		if value == 2

	end

end

	mut total := 0
	values&.each { |key, value| total += key.size() + value }

cases.title: Safe collection transforms
cases.declarations:
def integer_or(value: Integer?, fallback: Integer): Integer
	if value == nil
		return fallback
	end
	return value
end

def truth(value: Boolean?): Boolean
	if value == nil
		return false
	end
	return value
end

def initial(mut calls: Array<Integer>): Integer
	calls.push(10)
	return 10
end

def summarize(values: Array<Integer>?, mut calls: Array<Integer>)
	puts(values&.map { |value| calls.push(value); value + 1 } == nil)
	puts(integer_or(values&.select { |value| value > 1 }&.size(), - 1))
	puts(integer_or(values&.reduce(initial(calls)) { |sum, value| sum + value }, - 1))
	puts(truth(values&.any? { |value| value == 2 }))
	puts(truth(values&.all? { |value| value > 0 }))
	puts(truth(values&.none? { |value| value < 0 }))
	puts(integer_or(values&.find { |value| value == 2 }, - 1))
	puts(integer_or(values&.find_index { |value| value == 2 }, - 1))
	puts(integer_or(values&.sort_by { |value| value % 2 }&.size(), - 1))
	puts(integer_or(values&.sort_by_descending { |value| value }&.size(), - 1))
end

def range_sum(values: Range<Integer>?): Integer?
	return values&.map.with_index { |value, index| value + index }&.reduce(0) { |sum, value| sum + value }
end
